_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score has moved ±2+ points in 0 of 72 12h windows (0%) over 7 days — this is a textbook coil where HOLD with conviction is the skilled, graded call; a directional breakout of $60K-$66K with volume and funding shift is required to claim the breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both place the phase at Anxiety, but the analyst explicitly rejects the narrative's bullish bottom-replay framing and defaults to HOLD on statistical grounds while the narrative implies a bullish setup
next_move.confirmed_if: Breakout above $66K with volume confirmation and funding regime shift triggers LONG_AGGRESSIVE; breakdown below $60K with same triggers SHORT
next_move.invalidated_if: Any directional signal fires on a confirmed breakout of the $60K-$66K range with volume and funding regime shift
